purpose: Enforce the announcement-immutability gate + admin carve-out at EVERY edit/delete signal apply site (direct known-row, buffered/deferred resolution, TTL-expiry materialization, tombstone-application) per DD-11, and complete the send-side admin moderation-delete carve-out that makes S7's admin Delete button functional end-to-end.

public_api.name: registerGroupAdminsProvider
public_api.description: Composition-root registration hook (new S8 export). Registers the live group-admin lookup the receive-side gate consults at apply time. Settable singleton, not a threaded parameter — see api.ts's module doc comment for why. Registered once by MarmotContext.tsx; fail-closed to [] on unregistered/DM-thread/throwing provider.

public_api.name: applyDeleteEditSignal
public_api.description: UNCHANGED signature (frozen seam). Internally now consults the announcement-immutability gate at its direct known-row branch for both delete and edit classifications before applying.

public_api.description: UNCHANGED signature. Internally now routes through the gate-aware resolveKnownRowAgainstStores for both the pending-signal buffer and delete-marker store.

public_api.name: tombstoneMessage
public_api.signature: (groupId: string, id: string, rev: number, authorization?: TombstoneAuthorization) => Promise<boolean>
public_api.description: chatPersistence.ts. Return type changed void -> boolean (true iff applied). New optional 4th param independently re-verifies the announcement/admin gate against the row's CURRENT content — defense-in-depth alongside api.ts's own gate, per AC-IMMUT-4/5 naming both as apply sites. Omitted by non-group (DM) callers, or by any test wanting pre-S8 unconditional behavior.

public_api.name: isInformativeAnnouncementContent
public_api.description: New shared module (lib/marmot/announcementFamily.ts). The ONE family-definition function S7's isInformativeAnnouncement (messageActionUi.ts, now a thin wrapper) and S8's gate (api.ts, chatPersistence.ts) both import and call — never re-implemented in parallel.

public_api.name: performGroupDeleteMessage (GroupSendDeps.isCurrentUserAdmin)
public_api.description: ChatStoreContext.tsx. New optional isCurrentUserAdmin field on GroupSendDeps. When true and the target is a PEER's informative announcement, the own-message-only send guard is relaxed so an admin can construct+send a delete signed with their OWN key. Non-admins and non-announcement peer messages are unaffected.

dependencies_allowed: immutability-ui's shared family predicate (S7's messageActionUi.ts now delegates to the SAME lib/marmot/announcementFamily.ts this story introduces — one definition, two consumers)
MarmotContext.tsx composition-root wiring (registerGroupAdminsProvider registration) — authorized external port per architecture.md's send-capability-injection precedent (S3)
dependencies_forbidden: immutability-ui (messageActionUi.ts's canShowMessageActions/UI suppression logic) — this story never imports or duplicates the UI-layer gate; each layer independently enforces from the same shared content predicate
